body: From the DM-182 re-review (orchestrator, this run): after 'Reassess now', a window focus re-reads the reassessment (dropping the cutoff from the identity at ReportScorecard.tsx:265 + useScoreRead.ts:62 focus refresh), contradicting 'when you asked' (:251) and the doc's 'read only on request' — skip the focus refresh for that read (or reword) and pin it. Fallback `measureSum` (reportScorecardView.ts:411) ignores unreported attempts; make it qualify as a lower bound too.
